I tried to get more into the issue, searched some materials, and found to be worth reading:

* https://breachattack.com/
* https://github.com/mpgn/CRIME-poc
* https://www.blackhat.com/docs/asia-16/materials/asia-16-Karakostas-Practical-New-Developments-In-The-BREACH-Attack-wp.pdf

Then I found a blog post:
* https://www.sjoerdlangkemper.nl/2016/11/07/current-state-of-breach-attack/

So, instead of keeping digging myself, I hope @Sjord  can give us a quick overview:

* for it seems, that mentioned attacks are not HTTP/3 specific
* are they still relevant?
* there seems to be plenty of pre-conditions for the attack to work - what are those?
